name: Breeze Canna Disposable | Fruit Punch
description:
Sweet and tangy fruit with tropical beach vibes.

Effects | Uplifted - Aroused - Happy

Dive into a vibrant mix of tropical fruits that delivers the ultimate punch of flavor with every draw. Enhanced with myrcene, beta caryophyllene, and limonene terpenes, this tropical medley provides soothing, uplifting, and relaxed vibes that make every session feel like a celebration.
